tooltip.name: Nature's Grace
tooltip.summary: Strengthens direct healing on wounded allies.

effects.text: Direct healing is increased by [b]20%[/b] when the target is below [b]50% HP[/b].

tooltip.name: Nature's Grace: Overgrowth
tooltip.summary: Strengthens direct healing on wounded allies.

effects.text: Direct healing is increased by [b]20%[/b] when the target is below [b]50% HP[/b].
Overhealing is partially converted into a [color=#70c8ff]Shield[/color], up to [b]10% of the target's Max HP[/b].

tooltip.name: Hawk Instinct
tooltip.summary: Accelerates the Griffon whenever it successfully stuns an enemy.

effects.text: When this monster applies [color=#ff7777]Stun[/color], gains [color=#70c8ff]Speed Up[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].

tooltip.name: Cinderblood
tooltip.summary: Each landed hit can ignite the target.

effects.text: Each hit has a [b]35% chance[/b] to apply [color=#ff7777]Burn[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].

tooltip.name: Cinderblood: Ignite
tooltip.summary: Each landed hit can ignite the target.

effects.text: Each landed hit has a [b]50% chance[/b] to apply [color=#ff7777]Burn[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].

tooltip.name: Cinderblood: Molten Core
tooltip.summary: Ignites enemies more aggressively and feeds the Drake's momentum.

effects.text: Each landed hit has a [b]65% chance[/b] to apply [color=#ff7777]Burn[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].
The first Burn applied by each skill grants [b]10% Action Gauge[/b].

tooltip.name: Frozen Scales
tooltip.summary: Builds Frozen Scales through successful Freezes, then consumes them to fortify the caster.

effects.text: Each enemy Frozen by [b]Glacial Collapse[/b] grants [b]1 Frozen Scale[/b], up to [b]3[/b].
Before casting Glacial Collapse at [b]3/3[/b], consumes all scales and grants [color=#70c8ff]Defense Up[/color] and [color=#70c8ff]Immunity[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].

tooltip.name: Frozen Scales: Everfrost
tooltip.summary: Builds Frozen Scales through successful Freezes, then consumes them to fortify the caster.

effects.text: Each enemy Frozen by [b]Glacial Collapse[/b] grants [b]1 Frozen Scale[/b], up to [b]3[/b].
Before casting Glacial Collapse at [b]3/3[/b], consumes all scales and grants [color=#70c8ff]Defense Up[/color] and [color=#70c8ff]Immunity[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].
Reaching [b]3 Frozen Scales[/b] resets [b]Glacial Collapse[/b].

tooltip.name: Frostborne
tooltip.summary: Prevents the Drake's frozen targets from being freed by damage.

effects.text: Damage dealt by this monster does not break [color=#ff7777]Freeze[/color].

tooltip.name: Frostborne: Shattered Fury
tooltip.summary: Turns broken Freeze into a furious counterattack.

effects.text: When Freeze is broken by damage, gains [color=#70c8ff]Attack Up[/color] and [color=#70c8ff]Crit Rate Up[/color] for [b]1 turn[/b].
Gains [b]15% Action Gauge[/b].

tooltip.name: Frostborne: Everlasting Winter
tooltip.summary: Prevents the Drake's frozen targets from being freed by damage.

effects.text: [color=#ff7777]Freeze[/color] applied by this monster cannot be broken by any source of damage.

tooltip.name: Thunderheart
tooltip.summary: Converts bonus Speed into offensive power.

effects.text: Damage increases according to the monster's bonus Speed.

tooltip.name: Thunderheart: Overclocked
tooltip.summary: Converts bonus Speed into offensive power.

effects.text: Damage increases according to the monster's bonus Speed.
Bonus Speed also increases Crit Rate.

tooltip.name: Short Circuit
tooltip.summary: Turns Speed Up into a chance to disrupt enemies.

effects.text: While affected by [color=#70c8ff]Speed Up[/color], S1 and S2 hits have a [b]10% chance[/b] to apply [color=#ff7777]Stun[/color] for [b]1 turn[/b].

tooltip.name: Short Circuit: Chain Reaction
tooltip.summary: Turns Speed Up into a chance to disrupt enemies.

effects.text: While affected by [color=#70c8ff]Speed Up[/color], S1 and S2 hits have a [b]10% chance[/b] to apply [color=#ff7777]Stun[/color] for [b]1 turn[/b].
Successfully applying Stun reduces [b]Stormbreak[/b]'s cooldown by [b]1 turn[/b].

tooltip.name: Celestial Authority
tooltip.summary: Punishes enemies that strike the Aether Drake.

effects.text: When hit, has a [b]30% chance[/b] to apply [color=#ff7777]Attack Break[/color] to the attacker for [b]2 turns[/b].

tooltip.name: Celestial Authority: Ascendance
tooltip.summary: Punishes enemies that strike the Aether Drake.

effects.text: When hit, has a [b]50% chance[/b] to apply [color=#ff7777]Attack Break[/color] to the attacker for [b]2 turns[/b].
On success, grants [b]20% Action Gauge[/b] to the living ally with the most buffs.

tooltip.name: Divine Grace
tooltip.summary: Blesses allies whenever this monster grants them buffs.

effects.text: Each buff applied by this monster heals the target for [b]5% Max HP[/b].

tooltip.name: Divine Grace: Enlightenment
tooltip.summary: Blesses allies whenever this monster grants them buffs.

effects.text: Each buff applied by this monster heals the target for [b]5% Max HP[/b].
Also grants the caster [b]+25% Accuracy[/b].

tooltip.name: Bottomless Hunger
tooltip.summary: Feeds on buffs removed from enemies.

effects.text: For each enemy buff removed, heals [b]10% Max HP[/b].
For each enemy buff removed, gains [b]8% Action Gauge[/b].

tooltip.name: Voidborn
tooltip.summary: Feeds on stripped power until the Void Drake erupts into a protected state.

effects.text: Each enemy buff removed grants [b]1 Voidborn stack[/b], up to [b]5[/b].
At [b]5 Voidborn stacks[/b], consumes all stacks and grants [color=#70c8ff]Invincibility[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].

tooltip.name: Voidborn: Transcendence
tooltip.summary: Feeds on stripped power until the Void Drake erupts into a protected state.

effects.text: Each enemy buff removed grants [b]1 Voidborn stack[/b], up to [b]5[/b].
At [b]5 Voidborn stacks[/b], consumes all stacks to cleanse all debuffs and grant [color=#70c8ff]Invincibility[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].

tooltip.name: Final Omen
tooltip.summary: Preys on wounded enemies that try to recover.

effects.text: When an enemy below [b]50% HP[/b] is healed, gains [color=#70c8ff]Attack Up[/color] for [b]1 turn[/b].

tooltip.name: Final Omen: Fulfilled
tooltip.summary: Preys on wounded enemies that try to recover.

effects.text: When an enemy below [b]50% HP[/b] is healed, gains [color=#70c8ff]Attack Up[/color] for [b]1 turn[/b].
Enemies below [b]50% HP[/b] receive reduced healing.

tooltip.name: Chilling Presence
tooltip.summary: Extends the enemy team's debuffs after every turn.

effects.text: After this monster's turn, extends [b]1 random extendable debuff[/b] on each living enemy by [b]1 turn[/b].
[color=#ff7777]Stun[/color] and [color=#ff7777]Freeze[/color] cannot be extended.

tooltip.name: Chilling Presence: Suffocation
tooltip.summary: Deepens the enemy team's existing debuffs after every turn.

effects.text: After this monster's turn, extends up to [b]2 random extendable debuffs[/b] on each living enemy by [b]1 turn[/b].
[color=#ff7777]Stun[/color] and [color=#ff7777]Freeze[/color] cannot be extended.

tooltip.name: The Hunt
tooltip.summary: Steals momentum from the enemy closest to taking a turn.

effects.text: After this monster's turn, steals up to [b]20% Action Gauge[/b] from the living enemy with the highest Action Gauge.

tooltip.name: Soul Vessel
tooltip.summary: Collects Soul Charges and converts them into offensive or restorative power.

effects.text: Gains [b]1 Soul Charge[/b] after using a damage skill, up to [b]5[/b].
Gains [b]1 Soul Charge[/b] whenever any monster dies.

tooltip.name: Soul Vessel: Last Rites
tooltip.summary: Collects Soul Charges and converts them into offensive or restorative power.

effects.text: Gains [b]1 Soul Charge[/b] after using a damage skill, up to [b]5[/b].
Gains [b]1 Soul Charge[/b] whenever any monster dies.
[b]Severing Blade[/b] grants [b]1 additional Soul Charge[/b] when used against a target below [b]50% HP[/b].

tooltip.name: Soul Vessel: Requiem
tooltip.summary: Collects Soul Charges and converts them into offensive or restorative power.

effects.text: Gains [b]1 Soul Charge[/b] after using a damage skill, up to [b]5[/b].
Gains [b]2 Soul Charges[/b] whenever any monster dies.
[b]Severing Blade[/b] grants [b]1 additional Soul Charge[/b] when used against a target below [b]50% HP[/b].
At [b]5 Soul Charges[/b], unlocks [color=#d9a6ff]Soul Recall[/color].

tooltip.name: Headless Rider
tooltip.summary: Empowers the Dullahan while it has a Named target.

effects.text: While [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color], gains [b]+20% Speed[/b].
While [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color], cannot be Silenced unless affected by [color=#ff7777]Oblivion[/color].

tooltip.name: Headless Rider: Unbound
tooltip.summary: Empowers the Dullahan while it has a Named target.

effects.text: While [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color], gains [b]+30% Speed[/b].
While [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color], cannot be Silenced unless affected by [color=#ff7777]Oblivion[/color].

tooltip.name: Deathless Rider
tooltip.summary: Defies lethal blows while hunting a Named foe.

effects.text: While [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color], gains [b]+30% Speed[/b].
While [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color], cannot be Silenced unless affected by [color=#ff7777]Oblivion[/color].
While [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color], survives lethal damage with [b]1 HP[/b]. After the attack, cleanses all debuffs and loses [color=#d9a6ff]Headless[/color]. [b]6-turn cooldown[/b].

tooltip.name: Death's Gaze: Death March
tooltip.summary: Carries the death sentence forward when a Named enemy falls.

effects.text: When the [color=#d9a6ff]Named[/color] target dies, the living enemy with the lowest HP ratio becomes [color=#d9a6ff]Named[/color] for [b]2 turns[/b].
Applies [color=#ff7777]Vulnerability[/color] to the new target for [b]3 turns[/b].
